annotations.title: Extract named fields of one PDF as JSON (paid, x402)

description: PAID: read named labels out of a PDF and get one JSON value per field (text, number or date), for $0.0100. We fetch it; no OCR. A label we cannot find is null, never a guess. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

kind.description: How to read the value: text, number, date.

label.description: The printed label to look for, at most 80 chars; matched case- and whitespace-insensitively.

name.description: The key this value comes back under, at most 40 chars; unique within one call.

maxPages.description: Read at most this many pages: 1..20. Omitted means 20.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL of the PDF, e.g. https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762v7.
